form.label: Check Point Log Exporter Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for Check Point Log Exporter RFC5424 structured-data syslog rows. Dashboard presence does not imply replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ action="accept" | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ action IN ("drop","reject","deny") | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ | stats dc(rule_uid) as distinct_rules
index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ | timechart count by action
index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ | eval checkpoint_blade=coalesce(blade,product,"unknown") | top limit=12 checkpoint_blade

index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ | stats count values(action) as actions values(proto) as protocols values(service) as services values(s_port) as source_ports values(rule_name) as rules values(protection_name) as protections values(user) as users values(administrator) as administrators by src dst | sort - count | head 25

index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ action IN ("drop","reject","deny") | table _time host hostname vendor_raw_action action src src_ip s_port src_port dst dest dest_ip service dest_port proto rule_name rule_uid protection_id protection_name attack blade user administrator marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ | stats count values(vendor_raw_action) as raw_actions values(action) as actions values(src) as sources values(dst) as destinations values(service) as services values(proto) as protocols values(user) as users values(administrator) as administrators values(blade) as blades values(protection_name) as protections by rule_name rule_uid | sort - count | head 50

index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ | stats count values(vendor_raw_action) as raw_actions values(action) as actions values(rule_name) as rules values(protection_name) as protections values(src) as sources values(dst) as destinations values(client_ip) as client_ips by user administrator | sort - count | head 50

table.title: Onboarding coverage by source, host, and sourcetype

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers values(hostname) as checkpoint_hosts min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

table.title: Recent raw Check Point Log Exporter events

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="cp_log:syslog" host=$host_filter$ | table _time host source vendor_raw_action action src src_ip s_port src_port dst dest_ip service dest_port proto transport rule_name rule_uid protection_id protection_name attack blade user administrator client_ip hostname marker _raw | sort - _time | head 100
